Name: Grandpa's Cane
Author: SingleMaltWhisky
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds Grandpa's Cane to the game. Marlon will send you the cane [size=3]by mail[/size] as you start on your 3rd day on a new save. From that moment you can also buy the cane from Marlon at the Adventurers Guild.

As your combat level goes up Marlon will also be selling stronger canes.

[b]This mod is still a work in progress!
[/b][/size]

Manifest.Name: Grandpa's Cane
Manifest.Description: Adds Grandpa's lost cane to the game.
